title: Function coverage for I-Am
purpose: Provide source-backed unconfirmed service coverage using a broadcast NPDU and a compact payload region beyond the unconfirmed selector.
expected_behavior: The target should parse the broadcast NPDU, identify an Unconfirmed-Request-PDU, and dispatch to unconfirmed service choice 0x00 with payload bytes available for further validation.
constraints_preserved: BVLC function 0x0B is used for Original-Broadcast-NPDU.
BVLC length 0x000C matches the 12-byte message length.
NPDU version 0x01 and control 0x00 are present.
issue_safety_notes: Uses only a source-backed unconfirmed selector and conservative extra bytes. No unsupported Who-Is or Who-Has claims remain.
